description:
Baltimore Ravens at Indianapolis Colts
The Indianapolis Colts host the Baltimore Ravens in NFL Week 1 in Indianapolis. The Colts started last season strong, but Daniel Jones' injury led to a seven-game losing streak and an 8-9 finish, while the Ravens finished with an 8-9 record.

title: NFL Football
description:
Green Bay Packers at Minnesota Vikings
The Minnesota Vikings host the Green Bay Packers in NFL Week 1 game at U.S. Bank Stadium. The NFC North rivals split their 2025 head-to-head series 1-1. The Vikings finished last season with a 9-8 record, while the Packers finished 9-7-1.
